verdict.rationale: Reclaim's core design is background autonomy. Users configure Habits, Tasks, Focus Time goals, priorities, buffers and Calendar Sync, and Reclaim then schedules, reschedules, syncs, adds travel and decompression time, auto-locks events, and updates Slack status without manual work (docs-34, docs-29, docs-33, docs-18, docs-21, docs-36, docs-41). Users corroborate that the bot adds things proactively and 'stays completely out of the way' (comm-3, comm-4, comm-9). Missing for 10: a general-purpose, user-defined automation/rule builder beyond the fixed calendar features, and documented visibility or logs of background actions.
